🎀 Join the Group for a FREE in-game Gift!

🎲 Roll for powerful Mechs
🤖 Build your own robot army
⚔️ Battle enemy machines automatically
⬆️ Upgrade your Mechs to become stronger
🌍 Unlock new worlds and explore dangerous zones
👥 Play with friends for bonus luck and stronger squads

Every roll unlocks:
🔩 Common bots
⚡ Rare combat Mechs
🔥 Legendary machines
👑 Secret experimental robots from the old world

The deeper you explore, the stronger the enemy robot armies become. Collect stronger Mechs, upgrade your team, and create the ultimate squad to take back the planet.

👍 Like the game and join the group for +1 Luck!

🔔 Follow for updates, codes & special events!

Inspired by Slime RNG and Pets Go!
